item.title: 351-Powered 1965 Ford Mustang Fastback 5-Speed
item.description: This 1965 Ford Mustang fastback was refurbished in the style of a GT350R in 2020. Power is provided by a retrofitted 351ci V8 paired with a Tremec five-speed manual transmission, and subframe connectors, traction bars, four-wheel disc brakes, and 15″ Legendary GT5 alloy wheels have been fitted. The engine is topped by aluminum heads, an Edelbrock AVS2 carburetor, and headers. The exterior features a hood with a scoop, an R-style front valance, and blue stripes over the white paintwork. item.description: This 1986 Porsche 911 Carrera cabriolet was purchased by the seller's father in 1990 and has remained registered in California and Colorado.
